title: Forgotten Cantrips
description: This Mana & Artifice addon expands cantrips by adding new ones that are to be obtained by exploring the world
body:
# Forgotten Cantrips

Forgotten Cantrips is an addon for Mana and Artifice that expands your magical arsenal with powerful, ancient magic. To learn these lost spells, players will need to explore the world and uncover rare scrolls of forgotten knowledge.

# Planned Features

### Currently being developed for the Beta

*   Spectral Bed cantrip: Rest through the night without resetting your spawn point
*   Spectral Boat cantrip: Travel the oceans with magical storage shared with Spectral Donkey
*   Summon Lightning cantrip
*   Spectral Donkey cantrip: Fast mean of land transportation with magical storage shared with Spectral Boat
*   Empower cantrip: Cast this cantrip to make your next spell more powerful
*   Villager progression resetting cantrip: Reset trading progression
*   Forced off-hand item consumption cantrip: Forcefully eat an item from your offhand! Could be food or even sand

### Release plans

*   Colossus Oak cantrip: Awaken the power of the earth and grow the tree before you to extraordinary proportions.
*   Learning System: the cantrips would need to be learned somehow and we're currently designing the system for it.

# Community suggestions

We're open to your suggestions and ideas! If you have your own vision for some cantrips or have other ideas, please, feel free to join the Discord community post [here](https://discord.com/channels/398610095585624074/1515390682100142171)!

Note: This mod is currently a University summer project built by a team of 6. We are in active beta and will be updating the mod on a weekly basis as we roll out the full exploration system and upcoming cantrips!
